# Welcome {.unnumbered}

**Bioengineering Practicum · BIMB265125** (T: 0 / P: 1 sks)
Master's Programme in Biology, Faculty of Biology, Universitas Gadjah Mada
Odd Semester 2026/2027

Teaching team: Matin Nuhamunada, S.Si., M.Sc., Ph.D. (Coordinator) · Dr. Miftahul Ilmi, S.Si., M.Si.

Practicum module (Colab notebooks, slides): <https://bimb265125.matinnu.org/>

This site is the companion to the practicum's weekly sessions: a condensed
version of each lecture deck plus the hands-on material for that week. It is
being built up meeting by meeting, alongside the course — right now it covers
the first two.

| # | Date | Topic |
|---|------|-------|
| 1 | 11 September 2026 | [Introduction to Computational Applications in Bioengineering](meetings/m01-introduction.qmd) |
| 2 | 18 September 2026 | [Modelling Biological Systems with Simple Differential Equations](meetings/m02-ode-models.qmd) |

Meetings 3–10 will be added here as they happen.

## Assessment

| Component | Weight | When |
|---|---|---|
| Practicum performance | 20% | Every meeting |
| Weekly journal / report | 30% | Before the next meeting |
| Project | 25% | Meetings 7–10 |
| Field visit report | 10% | After meeting 9 |
| Presentation | 15% | Meeting 10 |

There is no mid-term or final exam for the practicum.
